description:
You are the Head of Customer Support Operations at Horizon Digital, a fast-growing SaaS company. The previous manager left the helpdesk in disarray. Log in at http://localhost:8080 with admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!.

Audit and clean up the helpdesk by completing ALL of the following:
1. There are misrouted conversations — 2 conversations in 'Technical Support' actually belong in 'Sales Inquiries' (they are sales/partnership inquiries, not technical issues), and 1 conversation in 'Sales Inquiries' actually belongs in 'Customer Success' (it is a billing/account issue). Move each conversation to the correct mailbox.
2. Agent Raj Patel (raj.patel@helpdesk.local) currently has access to both 'Technical Support' and 'Sales Inquiries' — remove his access to 'Sales Inquiries' so he only has 'Technical Support'.
3. Agent Ben Harris (ben.harris@helpdesk.local) currently only has access to 'Sales Inquiries' — grant him access to 'Customer Success' as well.
4. Assign all currently unassigned conversations in 'Technical Support' to Raj Patel.
5. Assign all currently unassigned conversations in 'Customer Success' to Nina Kovacs (nina.kovacs@helpdesk.local).
6. Create a saved reply named 'Sales Inquiry Acknowledgment' with the following body: 'Thank you for reaching out to our sales team! A dedicated account executive will review your inquiry and respond within 1 business day. In the meantime, feel free to browse our pricing page for detailed plan information.'
7. Create a tag named 'needs-follow-up' and apply it to every conversation in the 'Sales Inquiries' mailbox that has not yet received an agent reply.
